From our roots to your moments ✦
Our Journey

Built from a family love for F&B.

It started in 1998 with Restoran Asyikin, later rebranded as Mr Lebai in 2022. CIKIN.CO was then created in 2026 to bring that experience beyond the shop — into weddings, celebrations, booths and meaningful gatherings.

1998Family F&B roots
2022Mr Lebai
2026CIKIN.CO
